title: finding(types,plugin-grid): eight declared ObjectGridSchema keys have no read in ObjectGrid, and the schema reference teaches two of them
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a declared surface the renderer does not honour, class (b). `reach:` named producer: `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`'s `ObjectGridSchema` example authors `showFilters: true` and `description` on an `object-grid` node, and `ObjectGrid` reads neither. Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) from the objectui#10976 dev report (PR objectui#11065, `out_of_scope_findings`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Measured (the objectui#10976 dev, on objectui `origin/main` `9b85600b0`)

Zero non-comment `schema.KEY` reads in `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` for eight keys `ObjectGridSchema` declares (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`): `emptyState`, `showFilters`, `description`, `keyboardNavigation`, `rowSpecActions`, `bulkSpecActions`, `name`, `placeholder`. Lit control: `showSearch` and `frozenColumns` hit. `keyboardNavigation`, `rowSpecActions` and `bulkSpecActions` have no read anywhere in `packages/*/src` outside `packages/types`. `ObjectGridSchema.emptyState` is documented as "Empty state configuration shown when no data is available."

PR objectui#11065 withholds these keys from `object-view`'s `table` slot. This card is the `object-grid` node's own face, where they are still declared and accepted.

## Why it matters

An author (or an AI) who writes `emptyState` or `showFilters: true` on an `object-grid` gets no type error, no validator refusal and no effect, and the schema reference teaches two of them.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Enforce or remove, key by key: implement a key the grid should honour (`emptyState` has a plausible product meaning), retire the rest from the type, the zod mirror and the docs example. Where `@objectstack/spec` declares the key (read the spec's `ObjectGrid` / list-view row first), the spec declaration governs (spec > implementation > docs).

## Dedupe

The 1035 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2231), were listed via REST and grepped locally:
- `keyboardNavigation`: 1 hit, PR objectui#11065 (the source);
- `rowSpecActions` / `bulkSpecActions`: 2 hits, objectui#6152 (open; the zod-mirror omission ledger, not the runtime read) and PR objectui#11065;
- `emptyState`: 5 hits (objectui#10976, #6152 and closed PRs), none the grid's read;
- `showFilters`: 9 hits, among them objectui#11013 (on hold; stored view rows) and closed list-view PRs, none the grid node's read;
- `ObjectGridSchema` near "unread": 1 hit, PR objectui#11065;
- lit control `ObjectGridSchema`: 15 hits (objectui#9547 on `onNavigate`'s docblock and objectui#7759 on mirror drift among them, neither this); absent control `qqzz_never_written_token_5151`: 0.

None carries the `object-grid` node's unread declared keys.
